subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Including**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Including **means to add or involve something or someone in a group or activity. (किसी समूह या गतिविधि में किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को जोड़ना या शामिल करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Including all the necessary ingredients, she prepared a delicious meal for her guests.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that something is being added or involved, rather than removed or reduced.
 
• So, 'including' is the most appropriate word here.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Excluding **means to leave out or reject someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को छोड़ना या अस्वीकार करना)
 
• **Diluting **means to make a substance weaker or less concentrated by adding another substance. (किसी पदार्थ में कोई अन्य पदार्थ मिलाकर उसे कमजोर या कम सांद्रित करना)
 
• **Dissolving **means mixing a solid substance with a liquid so that it becomes part of the liquid. (किसी ठोस पदार्थ को किसी तरल पदार्थ के साथ मिलाना ताकि वह तरल का हिस्सा बन जाए)
